name: layout-catalog
goal: Layouts contains reusable visual frames and shows each child slot in the shared title, image and page-usage card

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Layouts means a reusable visual frame with a child slot. Exclude routing hosts and layout options. Reuse component cards with title, capture and page consumers; clearly mark child content; preserve old URLs and current navbar order. Focused checks only; full CLI/native deferred.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: Opus 5.5 extracted ExplorerLayout and real child-slot previews. Layout cards reuse title/image/page-usage cards. Routing hosts stay components; layout options stay configs. Canonical URLs, legacy aliases and shared Web/Electron planning categories agree.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: Committed failing category/route checks and six before captures. Focused green: 90 root behavior tests; 689 Reports tests; 29 Desktop, 7 Planning, 2 Hub and collaboration checks; 18 layout-preview browser cases and 24 navbar/search cases. Source-ownership review guards retain original proofs.

steps.title: Run the relevant project verification commands.
steps.evidence: Focused verification passed: root and Reports lint/types; Reports, Desktop, Hub typechecks; source-bound root/Reports/Desktop/Planning/Hub/Collaboration audits; registry/readability/ownership checks; Reports build. Full CLI/native suites explicitly deferred by Daniel; no full-CI verdict.

steps.title: Exercise the affected UI path, require no unexpected browser errors, and capture fresh evidence with error diagnostics.
steps.evidence: Focused Layout browser proof 7fb2e354 retained 18 list, detail, history and real-layout images at ba0a9603d; desktop and mobile pixels inspected. Canonical title guard has retained red 3784a7a7 / green 20175d89. Desktop link, thumbnail and getter-order checks pass with lint; tenant naming guidance covers canonical/compatibility links and package tests/types/lint/audit. Combined-main catalog capture and live publication remain in the approved shared delivery queue; full CLI/native suites deferred.
